name: Lifelong Secret
source:
Sooner or later, all [u]secrets[/u] come out... Or don't they?

Take on the role of Anna and her brother and find out what the young girl's heart holds. You will have to experience life through her eyes, the eyes of a girl who has to struggle with the most powerful feeling in the world - love. Will she be able to hold it back, or will all the things she is trying so hard to keep deep within her heart one day burst out and destroy her whole life? Only time will tell...

[b]There will never be any incest (sex between brother and sister) in this story.[/b]

[From [url=https://nuar-games.itch.io/lifelong-secret]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迟早，所有[u]秘密[/u]都会曝光……或者永远不会？

扮演安娜和她的哥哥，看看这名年轻女孩的内心藏着什么。你将透过她的双眼体验人生，感受一个努力应对世上最强烈情感——爱情——的女孩的生活。她能压抑住这份感情吗？还是她一直努力深埋心底的一切终将爆发，毁掉整个人生？只有时间能给出答案……

[b]本作绝不会出现乱伦（兄妹之间的性行为）。[/b]

[摘自[url=https://nuar-games.itch.io/lifelong-secret]Itch.io[/url]]
